title: Cybersecurity - Part 1
description: Web cybersecurity covering OWASP Top 10, SQL injection prevention, XSS/CSRF mitigation, authentication security, API security, and secure coding practices. This submodule covers: Cybersecurity fundamentals, Network security, Web security, OWASP, SQL injection.
learning_outcomes: Understand cybersecurity fundamentals and threat landscape
Identify and prevent OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
Implement input validation and output encoding
